entries.title: Psalms 14:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. [A Psalm] of David. The fool has said in his heart, [There is] no God! They acted corruptly; they have done abominable works, [there is] none who does good.

entries.title: Psalms 14:2
segments: The LORD looked down from Heaven on the sons of men, to see if there were any who understood [and] sought God.

entries.title: Psalms 14:3
segments: All [have] gone aside, together they are filthy; [there is] none who does good, no, not one.

entries.title: Psalms 14:4
segments: Have all the workers of iniquity not known, eating up My people [as] they eat bread? They have not called on the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 14:5
segments: There they were in great fear; for God [is] in the generation of the righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 14:6
segments: You have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD [is] his refuge.

entries.title: Psalms 14:7
segments: Who will bring the salvation of Israel out of Zion? When the LORD brings back the captivity of His people, Jacob shall rejoice, [and] Israel shall be glad.
